The answer is B, about 40%. My earlier -40% matches the roughly 40-point gap I recalled, but the team note rules out -40%. A gap of -80 points would need Southern approval near 0% and approval elsewhere near 80%, which doesn't fit the poll figures I remember. So the 40% option is the one that fits, read as the rest of the U.S. minus the South. I'm still working from memory of the survey data, not a source I checked.
